verification_contract.describe: On-disk release artifacts this baseline is pinned to. Their digests must not change without re-pinning, because downstream lanes diff against these exact bytes.
verification_contract.digests_note: tests/release/test_1591_baseline.py::test_watched_artifact_digests_unchanged enforces these digests. SW-1591-CI-001 repaired the YAML and re-pinned contract-ci.yml here, from the known-red bytes 3c059942fe80149fad6473ded3bba926402bb372a7162e046b69dc6006cdb480; the baseline test explicitly anticipates this deliberate re-pin. The gate-1312 manifest digest must never change (immutable historical artifact). SW-1510-SDK-CI subsequently rewrote the same gate (repairing the cross-repository contract contradictions: the schema path, the canonical digest algorithm, the SDK pin and the installed-wheel ownership inventory, per criteria 1-3) and deliberately re-pinned contract-ci.yml here from efc00b540222b1e7cd9ef1e3c60f5f205247f3f3ba19f8fcbdae58b0086c1952 to 68cf32d66d8af7dc8bc2a5ab472dfd700bf0abf8e18afb75c2bf744d0854e366. The guard semantics are unchanged: the digest still pins the exact bytes and still fails on any later silent rewrite; only the recorded value moved with the intentional edit. The gate-1312 manifest digest is still immutable.
